summary: Simplex Dynamics announces two wellness initiatives, Stress Management Workshops and a Mindfulness Training Program, framed with nostalgia for a pre-digital era free from constant notifications. The workshops teach stress resilience through breathing techniques and progressive relaxation, while the mindfulness program offers guided sessions on slowing thoughts and 'unplugging'. The company says it aims to learn from the past rather than retreat to it, and invites all employees to participate.
one_line: Simplex Dynamics introduces Stress Management Workshops and Mindfulness Training to help employees unplug and find calm amid constant digital connectivity.
key_facts: Simplex Dynamics is introducing Stress Management Workshops as a new wellness offering for employees.
The Stress Management Workshops teach stress resilience, including breathing techniques and progressive relaxation.
Simplex Dynamics also presents a Mindfulness Training Program.
The Mindfulness Training Program uses guided sessions to help employees slow the frenetic pace of their thoughts and awaken to the present moment.
The mindfulness program is described as a homage to the 'forgotten art of unplugging'.
The note frames both programs through nostalgia for a time before constant digital notifications, emails and handheld screens.
Simplex Dynamics states its aim is 'not to retreat to the past but to glean from its wisdom'.
The programs are meant to help employees cope with today's rapid digital flow while recalling slower, less connected times.
Simplex Dynamics invites all employees to take part in the programs.
The note's call to action hopes 'unplugging' becomes a daily practice rather than a wistful memory.
